Sign language is a real language. People talk with their hands, face and body.
Every sign has five parts: handshape, location, movement, palm direction, and face and mouth.
Use your strong hand. Copy your teacher like a mirror, in the space in front of your body.
Fingerspelling uses one handshape for each letter. Keep your hand steady and move smoothly.
Move your lips while you sign. Shape the word with your mouth at the same time as your hands.
Your face is part of sign language. Raise or squeeze your eyebrows for questions.
The camera works like a mirror and never goes on the internet. Hold each sign still to earn up to three stars.
